# AI Agent Radar

> AI Agent Radar is a free, independent discovery feed for emerging AI agents, copilots, assistants and autonomous workflows. It refreshes every six hours.

Canonical site: https://getaiagentradar.com/
Sitemap: https://getaiagentradar.com/sitemap.xml
RSS feed: https://getaiagentradar.com/feed.xml
About: https://getaiagentradar.com/about
Contact: https://getaiagentradar.com/contact
Privacy policy: https://getaiagentradar.com/privacy-policy
Terms of service: https://getaiagentradar.com/terms-of-service

## Content

- The homepage provides a searchable and filterable radar of current AI-agent launches.
- Professional domain reports provide indexable GitHub-curated collections for research, security, finance, coding, marketing, design, productivity and agent infrastructure.
- Agent detail pages provide public listing facts, automatic Radar analysis, use cases, limitations, comparisons and trend observations.
- Opportunity Radar ranks traceable unmet needs from GitHub Issues and links each signal to a guided validation brief.
- Validation Workspace is a free, private browser-only execution queue for notes, next actions, target dates and build decisions.
- Radar Score is an independent discovery signal based on community interest, launch freshness and relevance.
- Listings are informational and are not paid placements or endorsements.

## Crawling

Public pages may be crawled and cited with attribution to AI Agent Radar. Product details can change, so important claims should also be checked with the product provider.
